definitionZh: *webkit-progress-bar CSS伪元素代表了进度元素的整个栏. 通常它只是作为酒吧的未填充部分可见,因为默认它是在 *-webkit - 进步 - 值伪元素下制成的. 它是 " webkit-进步-内在元素 " 伪元素的孩子,也是 " webkit-进步-价值 " 伪元素的家长。
sourceDefinition: The ::-webkit-progress-bar CSS pseudo-element represents the entire bar of a progress element. Normally it's only visible as the unfilled portion of the bar, since by default it's rendered below the ::-webkit-progress-value pseudo-element. It is a child of the ::-webkit-progress-inner-element pseudo-element and the parent of the ::-webkit-progress-value pseudo-element.
